content: निर्माणम् .²1 Measuring, meting out; यतश्चाध्वकालनिर्माणम् <ls>P. I. 4. 31. Vārt.</ls> .²2 Measure, reach, extent; अयमप्राप्तनिर्माणः (बालः) <ls>Rām.</ls> ‘not having reached the full measure of growth’. .²3 Producing. forming, making, creation, formation, manufacture; त्रैलोक्यनिर्माणकरं जनित्रम् <ls>Mb. 5. 71. 7</ls>; ईदृशो निर्माणभागः परिणतः <ls>U. 4</ls>. .²4 A creation, created thing or object, form; निर्माणमेव हि तदादरलालनीयम् <ls>Māl. 9. 49</ls>. .²5 A shape, make, figure; शरीरनिर्माणसदृशो नन्वस्यानुभावः <ls>Mv. 1</ls>. .²6 Composition, work. .²7 A building. .²8 A part, portion. .²9 Essence, pith, marrow. .²10 (With Buddhists) Transformation. .²11 Happening, birth; पूर्वनिर्माणबद्धा हि कालस्य गतिरीदृशी <ls>Rām. 7. 106. 2</ls>. .{@-णा@} Fitness, propriety, decorum.
